original_benchmark.notes: MM (multimodal) subset of MedXpertQA, test split. The original harness calls chat-completion APIs directly (zero-shot CoT, two turns). The 5-example MM dev split holds few-shot demonstrations and is not adapted. The Text subset (2,450 questions) is out of scope for this adapter.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity experiments not run yet. Planned on the 201-task subset from --split parity (10% of each medical_task x question_type stratum, seed 42) with the added medxpertqa-llm agent, which sends the same two chat-completion requests as the original harness.
